delta: Add copied list<u8> inputs without lossy UTF-8 conversion; old text APIs share exact parser, bounds and error precedence.
Add explicit caller-fallback compact-or-bytes projection using the same bounded compact parser; original eight APIs and logic remain unchanged.
Add independent utf8.encode using Rust String::into_bytes; all thirteen JSON operations and the original parser/selector logic remain unchanged.
Add owned JSON string pointer projection with caller fallback; same existing selection bounds/errors and serde_json string decoding, with no Host access.
Add parse-once record inspection and owned text projections; existing ten APIs and original parser/selector logic remain unchanged.
Add record selection views without reparsing or changing the original six APIs: missing is present=false/json empty; JSON null is present=true/json null.
Bound input/output bytes, nesting depth, pointer count and pointer length; all results publish only on success.
Errors are bounded public enum cases; strict pointer syntax errors are distinct from missing values.
JSON values stay adapter-private; selected values cross WIT as optional compact JSON strings.
Pinned std and float_roundtrip features retain upstream i64/u64/f64 behavior, sorted keys and last-key-wins duplicates; not canonical JSON.
